claude.performance_metric: acquired whole and deregistered ~33 months after closing; operations absorbed into acquirer (40 facilities, 18 jurisdictions), one holder of record; no separate public trajectory thereafter
claude.rationale: The slice documents that Pinnacle was acquired whole by Penn National on 2018-10-15, delisted and deregistered with a single holder of record, and its operations folded into the acquirer's consolidated regional-gaming portfolio, with the acquirer touting an expanded 40-facility footprint. No line documents any product/process incoherence (p4) or any operations-versus-organization/culture fracture (p5) over time; the deeper post-acquisition financial trajectory is explicitly coded uncertain due to consolidation and absence of a stand-alone public record, but that is silence, not documented disruption. Absent affirmative evidence of realized disruption on either interface, both pathways are coded 0.

gemini.performance_metric: acquired whole by Penn National Gaming on October 15, 2018
gemini.rationale: The slice documents that Pinnacle Entertainment was acquired whole by Penn National Gaming in October 2018 and subsequently deregistered. There is no documented evidence of disruption at the product/process interface (p4_pathway) or fracture at the process/organization interface (p5_pathway) during the outcome window.

grok.performance_metric: acquired whole by Penn National Oct 2018; delisted/deregistered; trajectory uncertain
grok.rationale: The slice documents only that Pinnacle was acquired whole by Penn National on Oct 15 2018, delisted (Form 25-NSE) and deregistered (Form 15-12B, one holder), with operations folded into the acquirer's consolidated portfolio; no product/process misalignment or operations-vs-organization fracture is described. Absence of any realized-disruption evidence across the window yields p4_pathway=0 and p5_pathway=0; deeper stand-alone financial trajectory is explicitly uncertain due to deregistration.
